Here, "[[Cookbook:Grilling|grilling]]" means [[Cookbook:Frying|frying]], as it does for the [[Cookbook:Grilled Cheese Sandwich|Grilled Cheese Sandwich]]. Elvis Presley was famous for consuming these with sliced [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]] and "burnt" [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]].

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
*2 slices white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
*[[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]

==Procedure==
#Spread peanut butter between bread slices.
#Spread outsides of bread with softened or melted butter or margarine.
#Cook in a non-stick [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] on medium heat, turning a few times, until bread is golden brown and peanut butter is melted.
#Serve with plenty of [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]].

==Notes, tips, and variations==

*Make a standard peanut butter and [[Cookbook:Jelly|jelly]] sandwich and cook it in the same manner; these are very good.
*Make a standard peanut butter and [[Cookbook:Marshmallow Creme|marshmallow fluff]] sandwich and cook it in the same manner. These are very good, but can be a bit messy.
*Substitute [[Cookbook:Almond Butter|almond]] or [[Cookbook:Cashew Butter|cashew butter]] for peanut butter.
*Other kinds of bread can be substituted for the white bread.
